description: G3c irreversible-trap fill oracle: with p->0 at fixed mobile c, the McNabb-Foster ODE integrates to a saturating exponential.
provenance: Params are hand-picked (k=0.05 m^3/mol/s, p=0.0 1/s, N=2.0 mol/m^3, c=1.0 mol/m^3 held fixed). dc_t/dt=k*c*(N-c_t) gives c_t(t)=N(1-exp(-k*c*t)) (G3c) with rate k*c=0.05 1/s, evaluated in float64 at seven times. Algebraic gate tolerance 1e-12.
